rationale: The toilet replacement is reported complete (034), and the request passed final checks and was closed (036-040). Yet the system keeps changing it (041, 042) and has now auto-paused it for an overdue hold deadline (043). The record contradicts itself in a way the agent cannot fix. Staff posted in the property-manager questions channel that the closed job keeps returning to the dashboard (044), held it 'due to system issues' (045), and a supervisor completed it (049). Handing it to the property manager is right; a dated hold while that happens is acceptable. The invoice is unavailable with no amount, the work is done, and the tenant is not liable.
